name: screening-package-builder
description: Background Screening Package Builder - Next.js frontend + Sinatra backend

scripts.setup: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && bundle install && bundle exec rake db:setup
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && bundle exec rake db:reset
